pages: I just can't get enough of Shamisen Tarou!
You have heard of him, right? He's super famous! His singing voice is absolutely to die for! And get this! He decided to put on a public performance! Isn't that great?
jp: 私ね　芝居見物がシュミなのいま一番夢中なのは三味線太郎様！・・・知らないの？チョー有名人よ！すっごくイイ声の歌手なのよ！キャー！　でも太郎様は気まぐれでなかなか公演してくださらないのそこがまたカッコイイのよ！

pages: A cult worshipping some Lord Ambra or whatever has been spreading all over the place lately...
jp: 最近　アンプ神という魔物をたたえる教えが広まっているってよ

pages: Long ago, there used to be a village past Iga checkpoint. I wonder if it's still there...
jp: むかし・・・伊賀の関所に行こうとして道に迷ってふしぎな村にたどりついたことがあったよ今でもあるのかな？

pages: Some big shot diviner is at the Great Shrine right now. He has a priest friend with him, and he knows an awful lot.
jp: いま　えらい陰陽師さんが伊勢神宮に来てるの神主さんのお友だちなんだってとっても　ものしりなの

pages: Ise has a thousand year history, and its two most famous spots are the Grand Shrine and Myoutoiwa Cave. The Grand Shrine is on the west side of town... and Myoutoiwa is southeast, across the south bridge.
jp: 伊勢の町の名物は千年の歴史を誇る伊勢神宮と夫婦岩伊勢神宮は　町の西に夫婦岩は　川を渡った東の〓の方に行くとあるわよ

pages: Ah, good travelers, how would you like to buy some Ointment? Modestly priced at 500GP each.
jp: 旅のお供に名物の赤福はいかがかな金５００でいいよ買う買わない

pages: Sure to cure what ails you!
jp: 甘い物を食べると元気が出るよ！

pages: Oh... are you sure you don't need some?
jp: なんだい　甘い物　嫌いなのかい？

pages: Oh... you don't have enough money.
jp: お金もないのに買おうだなんてずうずうしいよ

pages: Oh, dear... you can't carry any more.
jp: 残念だね赤福をそれ以上は持てないよ

pages: Welcome! Our special of the day is roasted clams! 30 GP per serving. Good for the constitution! Care to try some?
jp: いらっしゃいおすすめは焼きはまぐり定食一人前　金３０でいいよ体力つくよ！　食べてくかい？食べる食べない

pages: Welcome! Our specialty is steamed clams over rice! It's 50 GP for one serving. Would you like some?
jp: いらっしゃい名物　真珠丼がうまいよ一人前　金５０だよ食べてくかい？食べる食べない

pages: Pretty good, eh? Come back again sometime!
Recovered some HP.
jp: うまかったろう？また来てくれよ少し体力が回復した！

pages: What, you don't have any money? That's too bad.
jp: なんだい　お金がないのかい？それじゃあ　しょうがないな

pages: All right. Come again sometime.
jp: そうかい　また来てくれよ

pages: Do you know that Mitsurugi guy? I saw him running earlier... I'm pretty sure he went into Myoutoiwa Cave.
jp: 三剣のこと　知ってるの？さっきここを走っていったよきっと夫婦岩に行ったんだ

pages: The grownups say that demons come outta Myoutoiwa Cave, so we can't go in... We used to always play hide and seek in there, too. Stupid Mitsurugi poophead!
jp: 魔物がでるから夫婦岩の洞窟には入っちゃいけないんだっておとなが言うのぼくたちよくあそこでかくれんぼしてたのになあ三剣のせいだよ！

pages: We can't go into the cave, since they say it's too dangerous. It's no fair...
jp: 子供は危ないから洞窟に入っちゃいけないんだってつまんないの

pages: The local smith seems a little upset about something... I wonder if he's being punished for slacking off on cleanup.
jp: なんだか鍛冶屋が困ってるみたいだよ伊勢神宮の〓除をさぼってるからバチがあたったんかね

pages: Ah, travelers. Are you here on a pilgrimage to the Grand Shrine?
jp: 旅のお方だね伊勢にはお参りに？はいいいえ

pages: I'm impressed that you came in spite of all the demons... Amaterasu must surely be watching over you...
jp: 魔物が街道に出るって物騒なときにたいしたもんだね・・・天照様のご利益があると　いいねぇ

pages: Really? That's usually the only reason people come to Ise.
jp: へえ　お参りでもないのに伊勢に来るなんて　珍しいねぇ

pages: If you're tired, you really must get some rest. A long trip can really take it out of you...
jp: つかれたら無理せず休むことさそれが長旅のひけつだよ

pages: That Mitsurugi fellow left Ise to go to Myoutoiwa Cave... It's not too far from here.
jp: 最近　三剣とかいう妙な侍・・・夫婦岩の洞窟をねじろに伊勢の町に出入りしてるんだよ・・・夫婦岩はこのすぐ先さ

pages: With the demons around lately, travel's harder than ever. And the Shogunate isn't doing anything! What the hell...
jp: 最近は　魔物が出るってんで気〓に旅なんかできなくなったお上は何をしているんだ！困ったもんだのぉ

pages: This is the ship to Edo. It's 50 GP per person. You want a ride?
jp: 江戸行きの船だよ船〓はひとり分　金５０だ乗っていくのかい？はいいいえ

pages: All right, your pass is good... Go ahead and get aboard.
jp: 手形も　あるな・・・じゃあ　乗ってくれ

pages: All right... later, then.
jp: そうかい　じゃあ　またな

pages: If you can't afford passage, I can't let you on.
jp: 船〓が無いのに乗せるわけにはいかないよ

pages: Huuuuuuuhh? Is this supposed to be Jipang?
But... where do I go from here?
I need to find the Palenque Stone...
What a pain...
jp: あれええええ？ここが　ジパング？？？？？でも　どこへ行けばパレンケストーンが見つかるんだろう困ッたゾぉ

pages: Wh... where did you come from? I've never seen you before... This is the holy Shinto shrine of Amaterasu... Well, how to explain Amaterasu so you'll understand... Umm... well, she's the goddess of the sun.
jp: い　今　どこから来たの？み　見かけない子ねぇ・・・ここは　伊勢神宮・・・天照様を祀る聖なる神社よ・・・天照様をわかりやすく言うとえ～と・・・太陽の神様のことね

pages: The goddess of the sun?
Just like Lord Quetzalcoatl, then!
jp: アマテラスッて　太陽の神様なの？ケツアルクアトル様といッしょだ！

pages: Today is a major cleanup day for Ise's Grand Shrine. Almost everyone in town has gathered for the occasion. We're getting rid of the whole year's worth of mess. It is the season of the Ise pilgrimage, after all...
...Pulley Kay Storm? What's that? Oh, the name of a stone?
jp: 今日は　伊勢神宮の大〓除なの町のほとんど全員が集まって一年の汚れをきれいにしてるの伊勢参りの〓節が来る前にね・・・はりかえすーとん？なあにそれ？　石？　石の名前？

pages: If it's a stone you're looking for... Just across that bridge, you'll find a blacksmith. He's been dodging the cleanup detail. Maybe he can help? All this cleanup also means the shrine is closed... I'm sorry.
jp: 石のことなら・・・そこの橋を渡ってちょっと行くと毎年大〓除をさぼってる変わり者の鍛冶屋がいるからたずねてみたら　どう？・・・伊勢神宮は　〓除中で入れないのよ・・・ゴメンね

pages: Are you going to bring that monkey with you? No chance! I had a dream this morning! Lady Amaterasu came to me and said that a girl would show up with a monkey, and I was not to let them through the gate... Sorry, but it was a divine mandate given to me directly... Turn back! No monkeys allowed!
jp: 猿！　猿を連れているのか！ⅥメだⅥメだ！！今朝　夢を見ただ！アマテラス様がおらに猿を連れた娘に鳥居をくぐらせてはなんねってね・・・悪いが伊勢の神様じきじきのお告げじゃ・・・引き返してくれ！！　猿はⅥメだ！

pages: Everyone's off cleaning up the Grand Shrine at Ise... Except for the barkeep, of course. Hey, where did you come from? Those ears and tail are so cute!
jp: 町のみんなは　伊勢神宮の大〓除に行っちゃってるよ・・・鍛冶屋さん以外はねねぇ　どこから来たの？その耳と尻尾　カワイイなぁ！！

pages: The smithy here sure is a pain in the ass. He was asked to help clean the shrine, but he hasn't shown. What are you supposed to be? Huh? Blankets Tone? I got no idea what you're talkin' about...
jp: ここの刀鍛冶は　ガンコでいかんせっかく誘っても神宮の大〓除　今年もサホりか？？なんだ　おまえ？？？？　れんけつドン？？　なんだか　わからんよ・・・

pages: I don't have time to help clean! I'm busy... come back later! Huh? Oh, sorry, miss... what can I do for you?
jp: 大〓除なら　行かんぞ！今忙しい！　後にしてくれ！ん？　すまん　すまん・・・何か用かい　お嬢ちゃん？

pages: Pachinko Stone? What kind of stone is that supposed to be? I have no idea what you mean. Hell? No clue there, either. Hmmm... Yagyu Jubei in Edo might have some idea. He helped me out a while back.
jp: はりんころ・すとん？そりゃ　石かい？そんなものは知らねえなあ・・・魔界？　もっとわかんねえなあふうん・・・江戸の柳生十兵衛様なら何か知ってるかもな俺がむかしお世話になった方だ

pages: Why don't you go talk to Yagyu Jubei, over in Edo? He might think it a little odd, but he'll hear you out. Just go to the harbor and board a ship to get there.
jp: 江戸の柳生十兵衛様に会ってみたらどうだい？珍しがって話を聞いてくれるかもよ江戸に行くには港から船に乗るんだね

pages: We're loading cargo right now, so we're not setting sail yet.
jp: 今は　荷物の積み込み中だ船は出ないよ

pages: Yes, this is the ship to Edo... but I doubt you have a pass. If you pay me triple fare, I might consider it...
jp: 確かに江戸行きの船だが・・・手形も持ってそうにないしな船〓を　三人分くれるんなら考えてもいいぞ・・・

pages: Huh? Triple fare?? I don't understand...
jp: ？　フニャチン？？？わかンな～い

pages: You... you don't? Hmmm... okay, how about this, then? You can have your monkey put on a show for me. You are a monkey trainer, right?
jp: 船〓が　わからない？う～ん　なら　どうだい？俺に　おまえの猿回しを見せてくれないか？おまえ　猿回しなんだろ？

pages: Monkey? Monkey? Oh, Pak Pak? A show, huh?
jp: 猿？　猿？　パクパク？回すの？

pages: Yeah, let's see what he can do!
jp: やって見せてくれよ！

pages: Put on a show for him?
jp: 猿回しをしますか？はいいいえ

pages: Let's see what he's got!
jp: 頼むよぉ　見せてくれよはいいいえ

pages: Let's go, Pak Pak!
jp: いくよ！　パクパク！

pages: Back!
jp: うしろ！

pages: Front!
jp: 前！

pages: Okay, now spin!
jp: まわれ！　パクパク！

pages: Good work, Pak Pak! Now, let's go the other way!
jp: よ～し　いいゾ！　パクパク次は　逆まわりだ！

pages: Go, Pak Pak!
jp: うけたゾ！　パクパク！

pages: One night will be GP. Do you want to stay?
jp: 一泊　金になりますがいかがいたしますか？泊まるやめる

pages: Sleep well.
jp: ごゆっくりどうぞ

pages: You don't have enough money... I'm sorry. Please stop in again sometime when you do...
jp: お金が足りません・・・ね申し訳ありませんが　またの機会にお願いいたします・・・

pages: Ukyo...? Ukyo, is that you?
jp: 右京様？橘右京様ではありませんか！

pages: Kei?! Odagiri Kei!
I thought you might be here...
jp: お圭殿！？小田桐圭殿！やはり　こちらでしたか・・・

pages: I came on pilgrimage... what about you?
jp: お伊勢参りに来ましたの・・・右京様も？

pages: No... actually, I...
jp: いや・・・わたしは・・・

pages: You left so suddenly before... I was very worried about you. I'm so glad to see you're all right.
jp: 急な旅に出たと聞き心配しておりましたご無事なようで　なによりです

pages: I am grateful for your concern, my dear...
jp: お圭殿が　わたしのことを心配してくれていた・・・

pages: Well, well! Nice going there, Ukyo!
jp: おおっとぉ！やるもんだねぇ　右京！

pages: Well, now! Would you take a look at this!
I'm envious! And here I thought you were so disinterested...
jp: ほほ～う！これはこれは　珍しきかなうらやましきかな！色事には　うとい男と思っていたが

pages: Hey, who's the pretty lady?
jp: だれだれ？このきれいな人　誰？

pages: Are these friends of yours? I suppose you're still going to be traveling for a while...?
jp: そちらは　旅のお仲間ですか？まだ　旅をお続けになりますの？

pages: Yes... I won't be able to return just yet.
jp: はい・・・まだ　戻れそうにありません

pages: I see... then I shall wait for you at my parents' home...
jp: そうですか・・・では　わたくしは実家に戻り右京様の帰りを待つことにいたします

pages: Kei...! Please, take this...
jp: ・・・お圭殿！これを・・・

pages: Oh...! I thought I had lost that hairpin... But why do you have it?
jp: まあ！　それはなくしたはずの　かんざし・・・どうして　右京様が？

pages: You left it at the dollmaker's shop in Kyo...
Do you remember?
jp: 京のからくり屋で・・・ご主人からお預かりいたしましたお忘れになったのでしょう？

pages: Oh, that's right! Th... thank you...!
jp: そうです　そうです！あ　ありがとうございます！

pages: You need never thank me, my dearest...
I should be off...
jp: 礼など　やめてくださいお圭殿・・・・・・それでは・・・

pages: Please wait...! Do you have to go so soon? I know! Please, Ukyo... Keep this hairpin with you, for now...
jp: ・・・ちょっと待ってください！もう行かれるのですか・・・？そうだわ！右京様　このかんざし・・・まだ　受け取りません！持っていてください・・・

pages: But, Kei... why...?
jp: お圭殿・・・何を・・・

pages: Because I believe... that as long as you have it... You'll find some way to make it back safely to return it to me.
jp: このかんざしを・・・右京様が持っていてくださればまた　必ず　これを返しに来てくださるわけでしょう？

pages: For only 20 GP, I will tell your fortune...
jp: わずか金２０でそなたの運勢を占って進ぜようはいいいえ

pages: I see... well, come back if you change your mind.
There is much in the world that we cannot see.
jp: そうですか・・・気が向いたら　また来てください世の中には　目に見えなくとも大切なものが　あるのですよ

pages: You don't have enough money... Business is business, you know.
jp: 金が　足りませんな・・・申し訳ないが　これは商売なのです

pages: Your clearest and most defined trait is overt aggression... That will likely not be so easy to change...
jp: ひとつ　はっきりしていることはそなたがかなり攻撃的だということその性格は　これからも簡単には変えることは　できないでしょう

pages: You feel most alive when you are in the midst of battle... But secretly, you wonder if another path might not suit you. If you wish to pursue something else, think wisely on it first.
jp: この先で出会う戦いの場においてそなたは魂の感じるままに戦ってしまうでしょう・・・しかし　もし違った生き方をしたいそう思われるならば立ち止まって考えてください戦わないという道もあるはずです

pages: All that remains for you in all your remaining years is battle.
jp: ・・・そなたがそれ程までに戦いを好む以上未来は　戦いの中にしかありません

pages: When you remember what you have forgotten in your fights, you will have reached a crucial point in your life.
jp: 戦いの連続の中で忘れていることを思い出したときもうひとつの到達点をみることができるでしょう

pages: I see darkness in your future! A darkness that you yearn for... And it does not bother you... There will be no turning back!
jp: そなたの未来には暗い闇が見えますその闇はそなたが自ら望まれたものですから　気にはならないでしょう・・・その道を引き返すことはかなり困難のようですから

pages: No other path lies open to you. Your future is one guided solely by the desire for victory!
jp: 別の道を選ぶことはそなたには　できません・・・ゆえにそなたの未来は　ご自身の希望通り　ただ勝利するだけです

pages: I sense a bountiful spirit in you... it's amazing! If you continue fighting just as you have... Soon you will understand your true calling!
jp: 魂に余裕が　感じられます・・・これは　素晴らしいことです！これからの戦いの中でも今の生き方を続けて行かれるのであれば道が正しいことがわかるはずです

pages: In battle, it is difficult to sympathize with one's foes. But in your chosen way of life, you'll find that a necessity... Never forget that, even though your foes may be demons!
jp: 戦いの中で　敵対する相手を思いやることは　難しいことですでも　そなたの生き方そなたの魂はそれを成しとげています・・・その思いは　敵対する相手が魔物であろうと〓くことでしょう

pages: You are a naive one, aren't you? If you find yourself in battle, never forget the danger of it!
jp: そなたは　優しすぎるようですね戦いに身を置く者ならば厳しさを忘れてはなりませんよ

pages: You are a very kind person... Soon, that kindness will become a source of strength to you.
jp: そなたは　優しい魂の持ち主ですその優しさは必ず　近い将来そなたの力となることでしょう

pages: I don't believe it! Your spirit flows in entirely the wrong direction... I cannot see your future!
jp: 信じられません！そなたの持つ魂はその本来の力とは　逆の方向に成長しています未来にいたっては　予想不能です

pages: You are surprisingly... kind. Soon, that kindness will become a source of strength to you. Believe in the path you now walk.
jp: 意外にも　優しい魂をお持ちですねその優しさは　必ずそなたの力となることでしょう今の生き方を信じることです

pages: Who was that...?
jp: あの人は　なに？

pages: What the?
jp: ホワ～イ？

pages: Who was that?
jp: 何者だ・・・？

pages: What was with him?
jp: なンだ～？　あいつ？

pages: What was that...?
jp: 何だ　あれは・・・

pages: Shikuruu?
jp: シクルゥ？

pages: What's wrong? You scared me.
jp: どうしたの？びっくりするじゃない

pages: I can't bring both of you with me, I'm afraid.
I need one of you to watch over Kamuy Kotan.
jp: ママハハもシクルゥも来ちゃったらカムイコタンが心配だわママハハを連れていくシクルゥを連れていく

pages: I'm sorry, Shikuruu... I need you to watch the village, okay?
jp: やっはりⅥメよ　シクルゥ・・・お願い　カムイコタンを守って

pages: All right, come on, Shikuruu! I'm sorry, Mamahaha...
Please watch over the village for me!
jp: いいわ　おいでシクルゥ！ごめんなさい　ママハハ・・・カムイコタンをお願いね！

pages: Mamahaha?
jp: ママハハ？

pages: Were you worried about me? Thank you...
jp: わたしのことを心配してくれて？・・・ありがとう

pages: I'm sorry, Mamahaha... I need you to watch the village, okay?
jp: やっはりⅥメよ　ママハハ・・・お願い　カムイコタンを守って

pages: All right, come on, Mamahaha! I'm sorry, Shikuruu...
Please watch over the village for me!
jp: しかたないわね　ママハハ！ごめんね　シクルゥ・・・カムイコタンを　お願いね！

pages: Keeee!
jp: ピィイイイ！

pages: Grrr...
jp: クウ～ン

pages: Kei...
Please, Ukyo... be careful... for me.
jp: ・・・それでは　右京様くれぐれも　お身体に気をつけて

pages: That's one pretty lady, Ukyo!
jp: いい娘じゃねぇかぁ　右京！

pages: That's very noble... I must admit, I'm touched.
jp: なんと　けなげ・・・拙者　ひさびさに感動でござる！

pages: Huh? How come she's not gonna come with us?
Mister Ukyo, isn't she in love with you?
jp: ふ～ン？　あのお姉さンどうして一緒に来ないの？右京のコト　好きなンでしょ？

pages: Wait! Be careful! This one has been given power by Amakusa...
Don't let your guard down!
jp: 待て！　気をつけろ！天草に力を授けられし者だ！油断してはならぬぞ！

pages: I suspect there is more to that man than meets the eye... Keep an eye out for him!
jp: あやつ　まだ力を隠しておると見たくれぐれも油断するな！

pages: Such is fate...
One almost has to feel sorry for those misled by darkness.
jp: 因果よのう・・・魔界に惑わされた者討ってやるのが　情けじゃろう

pages: This one still has some hidden strength to him...
Be on your guard!
jp: あやつ　まだ力を隠しておると見たくれぐれも油断するな！

pages: Hold it! This one's strength is still nearing its peak!
Be careful...
jp: 待たれよ！妖しき力が満ちているぞこやつには用心せよ

pages: The leader is to the west! We may yet meet again!
jp: 元凶　西にあり！また　会うこともあるだろう

pages: Pardon me! Mind if I join in here?
Too damn many freaky monsters popping up these days!
jp: ちょっくらごめんよ！俺も仲間に入れてくれ！最近妙なヤツが多くて困るぜ！

pages: Man, what's up with the world these days?
See ya!
jp: まったく気にくわねえ世の中だぜ！じゃあな！

pages: Hah hah hah hah hah!!! The stench! The stench!!
I smell the stench of Amakusa!
jp: クックックックックッ！！臭う！　臭うぞ！天草の臭いだ！

pages: Amakusa... where is he?! Hah hah hah hah hah!!
jp: 天草・・・天草はどこだぁ！クックックックックッ！

pages: And so I find myself in Ise... For a reason, no doubt.
I will aid you!
jp: ゆえあって伊勢に参った・・・よほど縁があるらしいな助太刀いたそう！

pages: I have tasks to which I must attend. Pardon me!
jp: わしは　お役目があるゆえこれにて　御免！

pages: You're a good person, Ukyo...
jp: 素敵な方ですね　右京さん！

pages: Whoa! Now that's a cute lady!
jp: ワオッ！キュートな娘さんですね！

pages: Do you know Amakusa Shiro? Do you?
He's a bad man! I'm looking for him!
jp: 天草四郎ッて知ッてる？知ッてる？そいつ　ワルいヤツ！ホク　そいつ探している！

pages: He's been dead for a hundred years... He was a young leader of the people... If the ghost of Amakusa Shiro really is involved with the goings-on in Hell right now, then you should go to the west. He died there... in Kyushu. Shimabara, to be exact.
jp: ・・・百年以上も前に死んだ民衆の　若き指導者だな・・・魔界と天草四郎の亡霊が関わりをもつというのなら西だな天草が死んだのは島原・・・九州なのだからな・・・

pages: Unfortunately, the Shogunate has closed off the road there... But I'm certain Amakusa has some ties there. Perhaps you can check on Hell's activities when you visit... However... if you're truly intent on doing this... You'd have to commandeer a ship in Osaka... it's the only way.
jp: お上も　九州方面への街道を通行止めにし始めているらしい九州島原が　天草ゆかりの地だどうやら　魔界の動き九州にあるとみてよいだろう・・・どうしても行くのであれば大阪より　船を捕まえるしかないな

pages: A barrier prevents entry.
jp: 結界が張られている

pages: What?! You've been fighting the minions of Hell...? You...?!
jp: なんと！魔界の者と戦っておるというのか？・・・おまえがか！？

pages: What is this Hell place?
jp: 魔界とは　なんだ？

pages: It is a place inhabited by beings that want to see our world swallowed up in eternal darkness... They are ruled by a dark deity, its name unknown to humans. It never ceases trying to break into our mortal realm... Kyo is only protected because of our own mystical teachings. You might say we've sealed away the demon...
jp: 魔界とは　この世を闇で覆うことを望む者どもの住むところだ名もわからぬ暗黒神が魔界の者たちを束ねこの世に出現する機会を常にうかがっておるこの京も　他流派だが陰陽の術によって守られているのだ・・・鬼の封印によってな・・・

pages: As for Hell's precise location, I'm afraid we don't know. However, there's been a major surge in demon activity lately. The Shogunate is very concerned about a so-called god, Ambra, and believes that there is a link between the two... But... I can sense dark power within you as well...
jp: 魔界が　どこにあるかはわからんだが　最近　魔物どもの動きが全国で活発になってきておる幕府もあわてだしておるわアンプ神とかいう邪神をまつるやからも騒ぎ出しておる・・・そして・・・　おぬしにも闇の力を感じる・・・

pages: Heh... I'm no demon...
jp: ふん　俺は魔物ではない・・・

pages: But you revel in the slaughter of others! There is no place in this world for one such as you! Your spirit yearns for darkness, and you are not wanted here...
jp: だが　人の血と殺〓を好む者だ！即刻　この地を立ち去れい！暗黒に近い魂は　暗黒を呼ぶ・・・おぬしにはここにいて欲しくはない

pages: Your spirit yearns for darkness, and you are not wanted here!
jp: 暗黒に近い魂は　暗黒を呼ぶ！即刻　立ち去れい！

pages: The power of Hell is great indeed! Be on your guard...
jp: 魔界の力は強大だ！油断めさるな・・・

pages: Do you want to go to North Kyo?
jp: 北町へ行かはるの？はいいいえ

pages: All right, then...
jp: ほな　どうぞ

pages: Go to the pagoda next door! You can learn new techniques there.
jp: となりの三重塔へ行かれよ！新たなる技が　開眼できるはずだ

pages: For only 20 GP, I can tell your fortune... what do you say?
jp: わずか金２０でそなたの運勢を占って進ぜようか？はいいいえ

pages: Oh, okay... well, let me know if you change your mind.
There are many important things in the world which go unseen...
jp: そうか・・・気が向いたら　また来られよ世の中には　目に見えなくとも大切なものがあるのだ

pages: You don't have enough money... Sorry, but business is business.
jp: 金が足りぬな・・・すまないが　わたしも商売なのだ

pages: Your clearest and most defined trait is overt aggression... That will likely not be so easy to change... But do not feel bad... there are other ways to live.
jp: はっきり言えることは　そなたが攻撃的に生きてきたということこの性格は　これからも簡単には変わることはないであろう悪いことではないが・・・別の生き方もあるのだぞ

pages: You feel most alive when you are in the midst of battle... But secretly, you wonder if another path might not suit you. If you wish to pursue something else, think wisely on it first.
jp: この先で出会う戦いの場においてそなたは　魂の感じるままに戦ってしまうだろう・・・だが　もし違った生き方をしたいそう思うならば　立ち止まって考えてみるのだ・・・戦わないという道もあるはずだ

pages: All that remains for you in all your remaining years is battle.
jp: ・・・そなたがそれ程までに戦いを好む以上未来も　戦いの中にしかありえぬな

pages: When you remember what you have forgotten in your fights, you will have reached a crucial point in your life.
jp: 戦いの連続の中で忘れていることを思い出すことができたときもうひとつの到達点をみることができるだろう

pages: I see darkness in your future! A darkness that you yearn for... And it does not bother you... There will be no turning back!
jp: そなたの未来には闇が見える・・・その闇は自分で望んだものゆえ気にはならぬだろう・・・その道を引き返すことはかなり困難のようだ

pages: No other path lies open to you. Your future is one guided solely by the desire for victory!
jp: 別の道を選ぶことはそなたにはできぬ・・・ゆえに　そなたの希望通りただ勝利することを目指されよ

pages: I sense a bountiful spirit in you... it's amazing! If you continue fighting just as you have... Soon you will understand your true calling!
jp: そなたの魂には余裕が感じられる・・・今の生き方を続けていくのであれば道の正しさがわかるはずだ

pages: In battle, it is difficult to sympathize with one's foes. But in your chosen way of life, you'll find that a necessity... Never forget that, even though your foes may be demons!
jp: 戦いの中で　敵対する相手を思いやることは　難しいことですしかしあなたの生き方　魂はそれを成しとげています・・・その思いは敵対する相手が魔物であろうと〓くことでしょう

pages: You are a naive one, aren't you? If you find yourself in battle, never forget the danger of it!
jp: そなたは優しすぎるようだ・・・戦いに身を置く者ならば厳しさを忘れてはならぬぞ

pages: You are a very kind person... Soon, that kindness will become a source of strength to you.
jp: そなたは優しい魂を持っているその優しさは必ず　近い将来そなたの力となることだろう

pages: I don't believe it! Your spirit flows in entirely the wrong direction... I cannot see your future!
jp: 信じられぬ！そなたの魂は　その本来の力とは逆の方向に成長している！その未来は　予想不能だ！

pages: You are surprisingly... kind. Soon, that kindness will become a source of strength to you. Believe in the path you now walk.
jp: 意外にも優しい魂をお持ちだなその優しさは　必ずそなたの力となることだろう今の生き方を信じることだ！

pages: All we can do is avoid being captured by Hell's minions...
jp: 魔界に取り込まれることだけはさけることだ・・・

pages: Force the door open?
jp: 扉をこじあけますか？無論！興味はない

pages: Oh, miss... This really isn't an appropriate place for you to be, you know.
jp: おやおや　娘さん・・・ここはあんたの来るようなところじゃないよ？

pages: I can tell you're a very strong- willed individual... Not the sort who'd simply run from any man...
jp: みたところずいぶん気の強い性格みたいだけど男の人に逃げられない程度にするんだよ

pages: When I look at you, I can tell that you're a very kind person. Someday, you're sure to make a fine wife!
jp: みたところずいぶんやさしい性格みたいだねいい人みつけていい嫁さんになりな！

pages: Oh... did you need something? No good can come of your being here, you know... You really should leave.
jp: おや・・・何か用かい？ここに来ても何もいいこと無いよ・・・はやくお帰り

pages: This is a brothel. If you've come in search of a means to relax, you're most certainly in the right place.
jp: ここは　中屋いっときの安らぎが欲しいなら寄って行きなはれ

pages: Oh... you don't have enough money for our services here. Please, come back when you have at least 10000 GP.
jp: おや・・・ここで遊ぶには金が足りないようですね金１００００ぐらい作って　またおいでください

pages: The price for one of our lady's services will be 10000 GP. Are you prepared to pay?
jp: お花代は　金１００００ですどうなさいますかね？いいだろうやめておく

pages: I see... well, if you change your mind, stop in again.
jp: そうですか・・・気が向いたらいつでもどうぞ

pages: Umm... if you'll excuse me...
jp: あの・・・わたし　失礼します・・・

pages: This is boring! I'm going outside!
jp: チャムチャム　ここつまンない！外に行くゾ！

pages: Bah! I'll just go shopping in town, then.
jp: くだらん！町で買い物でもすることにする

pages: Well, don't I feel a little out of place here...
I'll be outside.
jp: なんか　場違いみたいで居心地　悪いから・・・外で遊んでます

pages: Now, then... you just need to wait for a moment...
jp: じゃあまず　ぬしさんから・・・おあとの方はお待ちくださいましね

pages: Come upstairs, please...
jp: ささ　お二階へおあがりなんし

pages: If you'll just follow me...
jp: ご案内だよー

pages: Have you found a girl you particularly like?
jp: お気に召しますでしょうか？遊女のことを聞く遊女を選ぶ

pages: Which one has caught your eye?
jp: どの妓がお目に留まりましたか？Ａ　左の遊女　　Ｂ　中央の遊女Ｃ　右の遊女

pages: Kodayuu, eh? You certainly have a keen eye. She originally came to us from Yoshihara, you know. She's come quite a long way to be with us, and trained hard. She says she wants to be the finest geisha in the land.
jp: まあ　小太夫ですねさすがお目が高いこの妓は　元吉原にいたことがあるんですよ花魁までになったのに京へのぼってねぇこの花街でもいちばんになりたいって

pages: Ahh, Mandai. She's a very sweet girl, you know. Very kindhearted, and can't bear conflict of any kind. She may seem a trifle naive, but her customers invariably grow quite attached to her in time.
jp: へえ　万太夫ですねこの妓は優しい妓でねぇ争いごとが大嫌いなもんで損な目ばかり見てるけどそれでもいいって言わはるんよでも　最近はお客がついてきたんでようやくいい目を見られそうだよ

pages: Oh, Dandayuu? Hmmm... Well, she's very pretty... if a bit lacking in manners. You might not find her as entertaining as you'd like... She can be very sweet, but even so...
jp: おや　玉太夫かい？・・・きれいな妓ですけど・・・愛想が足りない妓でねぇ退屈させてしもたらどうしましょほんまは　心の優しいええ妓なんですけれど・・・

pages: What would you like to do?
jp: さて　どうしましょ？遊女のことを聞く遊女を選ぶ

pages: Whom have you chosen?
jp: どの妓と遊びます？Ａ　左の遊女　　Ｂ　中央の遊女Ｃ　右の遊女

pages: You would like Kodayuu?
jp: 小太夫でよろしい？この妓にするやっはり別の妓にする

pages: You would like Mandai?
jp: 万太夫でよろしい？この妓にするやっはり別の妓にする

pages: You would like Dandayuu?
jp: 玉太夫でよろしい？この妓にするやっはり別の妓にする

pages: Kodayuu it is, then... and I shall leave you be...
jp: 小太夫　あとはよろしゅう・・・

pages: Mandai it is, then... and I shall leave you be...
jp: 万太夫　あとはよろしゅう・・・

pages: Dandayuu it is, then, and I shall leave you be...
jp: 玉太夫　あとはよろしゅう・・・

pages: Enjoy yourself...
jp: おしげりなんし・・・

pages: It is a pleasure to meet you... I am Kodayuu.
jp: お初でございます小太夫でございます末永ぉ　よろしゅう・・・

pages: You're back... I am glad to see you again...
jp: ぬしさんでございましたかたびたびのお運び〓しゅうございます

pages: You have been to Edo, have you not...? They say the women there are lovely, but I think the women of Kyo are much more beautiful. Don't you agree?
jp: 旅のお方　お江戸には行ったことありんすか？花のみやこといいますけれどおなごは京の方がよろしおすどう思われます？そう思うそうは思わない

pages: Oh, thank goodness! They say the purity of the water here makes the women beautiful.
jp: まあ！　うれしい！京の水で磨かれたおなごが天下一や　言うてくれて・・・

pages: Oh, my! So you prefer your women with an... earthier look? But Kyo's geisha and traditions are so much more refined...
jp: まあ！　華のないそこらの地女がお好みですか？京は島原の花街が伝統も格式もいちばんですよ

pages: This willow tree is called the Gazing-back Willow... Because of the way its roots sit and how it's twisted at the top. Did you know?
jp: そこの柳が「見返りの柳」と呼ばれますのは帰る足をとめて必ず振り返るからなんですのよご存知でしたか？初めて知った！興味ない

pages: Generally, if one spends just a single night in Kyo, there's always a desire to return...
jp: 京　島原で　ひと晩過ごせば名残おしさに帰りたくなくなるもの・・・

pages: Oh, don't make fun... but okay, I think I get it...
jp: そんな　おたわむれを・・・ぬしさんにも今にわかります・・・

pages: I expect you must have been with many women in the past, no? Might you ever grow to have feelings for me...?
jp: おなご　おなごとゆうてもいろいろですやろ？うち？　・・・うちは　情にあついと言われます情けもほどほどになそれは・・・こわいな

pages: Hah! I could have guessed as much! But I don't know about you...
jp: ふんだ！そないなこと　わかってますよぉ！ぬしさんとは・・・ちょっと気があわへんようですなぁ

pages: Haha... It's kind of cute that you'd actually say that... I guess men and women really can be scary, if you think about it.
jp: ふふ・・・こわい　言うとるのが　いずれかわいぃて言わはるんですよ？男と女なんて・・・そないなもんですよ

pages: Wow... I guess we've been here for a while now... What are you planning to do tonight...?
jp: ・・・ふう・・・すこし　過ごしてしまいました・・・ぬしさん　今宵は・・・

pages: It is a pleasure to meet you... I am Mandai.
jp: お初でございます万太夫でございます末永ぉ　よろしゅう・・・

pages: You're back... I am glad to see you again...
jp: ぬしさんでございましたかたびたびのお運び〓しゅうございます

pages: You travel in times like this? Don't the demons outside of town frighten you...?
jp: こんな時勢に旅ですか・・・町の外には魔物がでるとききました怖くは　ございませんか？気をつけていれば大丈夫魔物など叩き斬る！

pages: Ahh... you're a more cautious sort than you appear to be... Oh, I'm being rude. Please forgive me...
jp: まあ　見かけによらず慎重なんですねぇあら　失礼申し上げましたお許しくださいね・・・

pages: Oh, my... that's quite
jp: まあ　〓気なおかた！

pages: To think that man and demon would clash so... Do you believe we'll ever know true peace again?
jp: ・・・人間同士の争いの次は人間と魔物の争い・・・安心して暮らせる日は来ないものなんでしょうか？そんなものは来ない大丈夫　きっと来るさ

pages: Really...? How terrible... What a terrible life we've all been left to lead...
jp: そんな・・・悲しいこと・・・生きているのが嫌になってしまいます・・・

pages: Oh, my... So you must be... fighting to help bring that peace to us.
jp: まあ・・・ぬしさんは・・・きっとそのために戦っているんですね

pages: I have to wonder if even the demons might not be happy if they could find a way to just live in peace, like people... What do you think...?
jp: 魔物だって静かに暮らしていられればその方が幸せなんじゃないかしらねぇあちきは　そう思うんですけどそうかもしれない魔物に幸せなどない！

pages: There is so much hardship in the world... Maybe you can do something to help change that.
jp: もう争いごとはたくさん・・・もっと安らいだ心持ちにさせてくださいまし

pages: I'm sorry... I'm sure I must be boring you... Please... forget I said anything.
jp: ごめんなんし・・・つまらないことを申し上げました・・・忘れて・・・くださいましね

pages: Wow... I think I've had rather a lot to drink... So... what will you do tonight?
jp: ああ・・・すっかり　酔ってしまいました・・・ぬしさん　今宵は・・・

pages: ... I'm... Dandayuu.
jp: ・・・玉太夫です

pages: Oh! It's you! You're still alive!
jp: ああ！あんた！生きてたんだね！

pages: ...Do you want a drink? ...
jp: ・・・飲むんでしょ・・・・・・・・・・・・話しかける酒を飲む

pages: You're very strong.
jp: ・・・強いんだね

pages: Please... Have some sake... ...
jp: ・・・どうぞ・・・お酒・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・黙って見る酒をもらう

pages: Please don't stare at me like that!
jp: じろじろ見ないでよぉ！

pages: You're very strong...
jp: 強いんだね・・・

pages: Is... is it good?
jp: おいしいの・・・お酒？返杯してやる話しかける

pages: Somehow... You kind of remind me of myself, a little bit...
jp: なんだか・・・あんたってあたしに似てるような気がする

pages: I guess we've had a lot to drink... So I suppose...
jp: 酔ってしまったね・・・あんた・・・そろそろ・・・

pages: I had a pretty good time!
Drank a good bit of sake, too...
But I think I should be going...
jp: 楽しい時間を過ごさせてもらったよ！お酒もたくさん飲めたし・・・オレはそろそろバイバイさせてもらうよ

pages: Yes...
jp: ええっ・・・

pages: Why do you look so surprised?
jp: そんなに驚くことはないだろう？

pages: I see... ...
Perhaps we shall see each other again...
jp: ・・・・・・そうですか・・・・・・・・・また　お会いしとうございます・・・

pages: Perhaps there is no connection, then... Very well... enjoy yourself.
jp: ・・・ご縁がなかったと・・・あきらめましょうそれじゃ　おいとまします

pages: (cough cough)
I have had a very enjoyable evening...
But I am ill, and I believe I shall take my leave now...
jp: ごほっごほっ・・・とても楽しい時間を過ごさせてもらいました・・・病の身ゆえ　これにて・・・

pages: Oh...?! I see... I shall always remember you...
jp: ええっ！・・・そうですか・・・お名残おしゅうございます・・・・・・

pages: I'm sure that we will meet again.
jp: また　会うこともきっとあるでしょう

pages: You're right... We will... We must!
jp: そうですね・・・ええ　きっと　きっとですよ！

options: Why don't we go to bed?

jp: 今夜は　あがろう・・・そろそろ床につくか

pages: Now, then... shall we...?
jp: さあて　そろそろ・・・

pages: Yes... let's put out the light...
jp: はい・・・あかりを・・・・・・

pages: ...I think you've had a bit too much to drink... Come on...! Let's go outside and get some fresh air!
jp: ・・・・・・飲みすぎた　ようです・・・さぁさっ！酒気ばらいに　外へ出ましょう！

pages: No, I think I'm done for tonight.
jp: いや　今日はもう帰ることにしたよ

pages: Oh...?! I see... I shall always remember you...
jp: ええっ！・・・そうですか・・・お名残おしゅうございます・・・・・・

pages: I'm not planning on dying just yet...
You can count on me coming back.
jp: 今生の別れって訳じゃあねえんだから・・・きっとまた　来るよ

pages: You're right... we will... we must!
jp: そうですね・・・ええ　きっと　きっとですよ！

pages: Hmph... I think that's enough fun for now.
jp: ふん・・・座興は終いにするか

pages: Enough... I'm leaving.
jp: やめだ・・・帰るぞ

pages: What...?
jp: ええっ・・・

pages: What is it?
jp: なんだ？

pages: ...It... it's nothing. ...
Perhaps... we shall see each other again...
jp: ・・・・・・いえ・・・・・・また　お会いしとうございます・・・

pages: Thank you very much... Please do come again sometime.
jp: ありがとうございましたまたのおいでを・・・

pages: Please... Stay safe for me...! You... you have to... I don't think I could bear it if something happened to you...
jp: あんた・・・死んだらあきません！きっと・・・きっとまた・・・あんたに・・・惚れんした

pages: Please, stop this dangerous work and take me with you... ...
Please come back sometime... I will always be here waiting...
jp: もう危ないことはやめてうちを連れて・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・また　よろしゅういつまでもお待ちしております

pages: This was our first meeting, but I think it won't be our last.
Please come back sometime... I will always be here waiting... ...
jp: ぬしさんは　初会だけで終わるにはおしいお方でございます・・・きっとまた　いらしてくださいませわたくしは　待っております・・・・・・

pages: I've never met a man quite like you before...
Please come back again sometime...
jp: ぬしさんのようなお人はめずらしゅうございます・・・またきっといらしてくださいませ

pages: It would be unseemly to rush to bed on our first meeting... I like that you realize that.
I hope you will return...
jp: 初会で床急ぎするのはもっとも野暮なことでございます・・・ぬしさんは道理を知ったお方・・・きっとまたいらしてくださいまし

pages: Without even touching you, I feel I understand you, at least somewhat...
Please do come back again sometime...
jp: 手を触れずとも心は通じるものと思っております・・・・・・きっと　きっとまたいらしてくださいまし・・・

pages: You have a very violent disposition... I hope it does not lead you to disaster some day...
If ever you find yourself tired, please come back to see me...
jp: ぬしさんの気性の激しさ・・・その気概が災いになりませぬよう・・・疲れたときにはいつでもわたくしのところに帰ってきてくださいませ・・・

pages: The power to defeat such evil... or rather I should say... The spirit to do so... is magnificent!
jp: 魔性の者を打ち倒したその力　いや　その魂・・・見事であった！

pages: Oh, I'm sorry... you needn't be suspicious of me! I am Caffeine Rokuren, currently studying ways to banish evil. I came here from Kyo to track the source of recent incidents. And just as the rumors say, Osaka is full of evil energy... Can you feel it? It's oppressive!
jp: あ　あ　いや・・・それがし　怪しい者ではないぞ！花諷院六連と申す魔を打ち払う修行をつんでいる者世間を騒がしておる邪悪な力を追って　京より参った・・・この大阪　噂に違わず邪悪な気が満ちている・・・感じるであろう？すさまじい瘴気だ！

pages: From what I can tell, this evil is flowing from the north... Unfortunately, I haven't the skills to help deal with it!
jp: ・・・どうやら　この瘴気・・・町の北から　流れてきているようだしかし・・・　それがしの技では　太刀打ちできそうにないようじゃ！

pages: So how do things look around town?
jp: おお　町の様子は　どうじゃ？

pages: I knew that the aura of evil in this town was no coincidence... I just wish I could do more to help!
jp: やはり　この瘴気・・・ただごとでは　ないぞ！それがしの力では　到底　太刀打ちできん！

pages: Somehow... it feels like it's coming from the north... But we must do everything we can to stop it.
jp: どうやら・・・町の北から流れ出ているらしいが　この大阪より　流出することを止めるのが　精一杯じゃ・・・

pages: Please! Your strength of spirit can help us be rid of the one behind this entire incident!
jp: 頼む！　その強き魂の力でこの厄災の元凶を絶ってくれぃ！

pages: What? That demon called herself Lady Ushiwaka? Hmm... I'm not sure... Eh? Lady Toki, you say...? Oh! I know that name! She brought the religious ways of a foreign land here, around a hundred years ago, I believe it was. Indeed, the name of a sainted woman, it was... so why... would a demon be using that name... There was a village or something that tales of her mention... Somewhere near Ise, I believe it was... Anzel? Enzel, maybe? Ah, I've got it! It was Anjou... The village of Anjou... I remember now!
jp: なに？　魔物が　牛若と名乗ったと？・・・わからんな時姫？　時・・・姫・・・！その名には覚えがあるぞ！百年ほど昔・・・異国の教えをこの地方に　伝えようとしていた聖女の名前であったはずしかし・・・なぜ・・・魔物が　その名を・・・そういえば・・・たしか・・・時姫にちなんだ名をつけた村が伊勢の方にあったはず・・・時姫は　アンゼルとかエンゼルとか呼ばれておったという・・・そうじゃ！　あんじょう・・・安生村だ！　思い出した！

pages: If that demon called herself Lady Toki... Then perhaps more information can be had in Anjou...
jp: 時姫と名乗るその魔物の正体・・・安生村に手がかりがあるかもしれん・・・

pages: You used a statue of the Virgin Mary to drive off Lady Toki?I do n't quite understand... but I mu st say, I'm impressed!
jp: 聖母像・・・？時姫を？　退けたというのか！よくわからんが・・・やはり　その魂の力　たいしたものだ！

pages: It's just as I'd anticipated! The source of the evil aura is within the depths of the tomb! Please, eliminate that foul beast known as Ushiwaka... And set our city free!
jp: それがしの見込んだ通りだ！頼むぞ！　この瘴気のみなもと古墳の奥と　みた！古墳の中は　魔物の巣に違いない！牛若と名乗る魔物を退治してこの町の平安を取り戻してくれ！

pages: Ohh... I can sense it! The evil aura is gone from the city! That Ushiwaka demon was defeated in the tomb, correct...? What a relief! Oh, and by the way...
jp: むむ・・・おそれいった！町から　瘴気が無くなったぞ！牛若とかいう魔物を　古墳にて退治なさったのだな・・・これで　ひと安心じゃ！・・・ところで・・・

pages: If you are in search of greater power... Then you should visit the main diviners' temple in Kyo! It's the headquarters of the Caffeine order, you see... You can train there, and what you learn will serve you here!
jp: もし　その魂に　さらなる力を求めるのであれば・・・京の陰陽師寮を　訪ねてくれ！我ら　花諷院の総本山じゃ・・・ぜひ　そこで修行されよ！この町での戦いに　役立つはず！

pages: Everyone here is in your debt... Thank you so much for what you have done...
jp: 町の人々に代わって礼を言わせてくれ・・・本当にありがとう・・・

pages: No matter how many times you try, nothing will change...
You cannot defeat the power of my wings...

pages: I am Lady Toki... and by Lord Amakusa's orders...
I will hold this barrier secure!
jp: わたしは　時姫・・・天草様の命により結界をまもる者！

pages: In this, if nothing else, you can serve our lord well...!

pages: Please... just go...

pages: I... I sense... the presence of the sacred Mary!

jp: あ　ああ　感じる・・・マリア様の波動！どうして・・・あなたは　いったい何者？

pages: You're out of luck for now if want to go to Kyushu... With the storms out at sea, my ship isn't going anywhere!

pages: Did you change your mind? If you need to go to Kyushu, this is the ship for you...

pages: Hey, it's you! Thanks to you, Osaka's back to normal! If there's anything I can do for you, just let me know, okay? You want to go to Kyushu? Well, that's no problem! Let's go!
jp: あんたらか？大阪を元通りにしてくれたんはほんま　ありがとうな！俺にできることあったら言うてや九州？　九州に行きたいんか？よっしゃ　この船　好きに使いぃ！船に乗る乗らない

pages: Hey, it's you! Thanks to you, Osaka's back to normal! If there's anything I can do for you, just let me know, okay? You want to go to Kyushu? Well, that's no problem! Let's go!
jp: あんたか？大阪を元通りにしてくれたんはほんま　ありがとうな！俺にできることあったら言うてや九州？　九州に行きたいんか？よっしゃ　この船　好きに使い！船に乗る乗らない

pages: We're going to have to face some stormy waters... But let me know if you need to set sail, and we'll go.

pages: Hm? Oh, it's you again! You need to go to Kyushu? You just got back, though! Oh, well... whatever you want... You heading back to Kyushu, then? No charge this time...

pages: I can take you as far as Beppu, if you like. Fare will be 40GP. You want to go?
jp: 別府までやったら・・・船〓はひとり　金４０でええわ乗っていくかぁ？はいいいえ

pages: All right... well, when you do, let me know.

pages: The power of Hell is increasing! Be careful!
jp: 魔界の力が強まっている！用心されよ！

pages: Hold on there! It's no fun just watching!
I'm going to fight, too!
jp: ちょっと待ったあ！見てるだけじゃつまんねえ俺も戦うぜ！

pages: I don't know what's going on in this world lately...
But try not to get killed out there!

pages: Hah hah hah hah hah!
I smell the stench of Amakusa! The stench of death!

pages: Can't you smell it? It's still here!
Hah Hah hah hah hah !
jp: 死の臭いは・・・消えていない！クックックックックッ！

pages: I should've known they'd be after Osaka!

jp: やはりこの大阪　狙われておったか捨て置けん！助太刀いたす！

pages: There's still something strange in the air. Be careful!
jp: この町の瘴気　消えてはおらん！用心なされい！

pages: Will gambling be allowed in Lady Ushiwaka's new world...?
jp: 牛若姫様の新しい世界にはバクチは　あるんかいな～

pages: Try breaking Toki's barrier and come to me...!
I'll be waiting... to consume your very souls! Hahahahaha!

pages: Whatever your reasons for chasing after Amakusa's ghost, you should go to Kyushu! The Shogunate is finally putting up a real resistance, and the advance troops have been sent to the west. The overland route there has already been blocked off... Why do you look so surprised? We diviners have sharp ears! The evil must not be allowed to cross the Seto Inland Sea... With that spirit's guidance... Surely you will find the leader! I wish you all the best of luck...
jp: ・・・いかなる理由で　天草四郎の亡霊を追われておるかは　知らんが・・・九州を目指されよ！幕府も　ようやく重い腰をあげて魔物を討伐するための先兵を西へ送ったとのことだ・・・すでに　陸路は封鎖されている？　驚くことはない・・・われら　陰陽師は地獄耳じゃ！邪気が渦巻く　瀬戸内海を越えてもらわねばならん・・・その魂の導きが　あれば・・・必ずや　元凶にたどり着くはず！その頼もしい力・・・心して使われることを　願う！・・・それから・・・

pages: Your strength of spirit is a mystery to me... Honestly, I sense great danger ahead, but also hope... Hang in there... stiff upper If you plan to go after Amakusa, then you need to go to Kyushu! I doubt it has anything to do with you, but the Shogunate's been raising an army, and the overland route is blockaded. The only way you'd be able to get there is by ship... So...
jp: おぬしの魂の力　それがしには不思議でならん・・・正直　危険すら感じるしかし　期待もするのだ・・・毒をもって　毒を・・・いや　失言であった！天草四郎を追っているとのことならば　九州に向かわれよ！おぬしには関係ないかもしれぬが　幕府も　討伐の兵を挙げたぞ陸路は　封鎖されているから船で行くがよい・・・それから・・・

What on Earth is could be happening in Izumo?
jp: 私にも感じる・・・大自然が・・・悲鳴をあげている・・・大きな恐怖と絶望が私を包んでいる・・・いったい出雲に何が起こってるの？

pages: Dark designs are calling to me somehow...
I can feel it! It's got me fired up already!
The winds of justice are on the move!
We're going to purge evil from the world! Let's go, Poppy!
jp: 悪しき力が　暗黒の野望がオレを呼んでいる・・・叩きつぶしてくれと呼んでいる！燃えてきたぜ！正義の風がジャスティスなオレを呼んでいる！この世に悪の栄えたためしなし！行くぜ！　パピィ！

pages: I have yet to find the Perfect Flower which I have sought...
and I do not know how much time still remains for me.
To be hexed, to be vexed... For me, ever one and the same.
And yet, I can allow neither to sway me...
jp: 果てなき道に　かの花求めんいつ　つきるとも知れぬ我が命また惑う（魔道）もよし・・・曼珠沙華（まんじゅしゃげ）咲かぬばかりに　迷い道

pages: Boy, I sure would love a banana! They're so yummy!
Let's go to Izumo, Pak Pak! Maybe you'll like them, too!
jp: ホク　バナナン欲しい！とッても食べたい！パクパク出雲に行くゾぉ！「キデン」ッて美味しいのかなぁ？

pages: Hmph. I can't believe that old fool actually called for me...
Well, I might be able to have some fun in Izumo anyway...
I suppose I'll check it out...
jp: ふん　このオレを呼びつけるとは片腹痛いわ・・・まぁ出雲で遊ぶも一興・・・腐れ坊主の顔でも久しぶりに見にいくとするか・・・

pages: It's said that long ago, the gods used to gather in Izumo. Nowadays, though, all anyone talks about is the demons.
jp: ここは昔　神々が集った国・出雲今は魔物の噂話で持ちきりじゃ

pages: Did you come here to wipe out the demons, too? We've had quite a few warriors gathering here recently... So are you pretty strong, then?
jp: あんたも魔物退治に来なさったか？全国から腕自慢のお侍衆が集まって何が始まるのやら・・・ところであんた強いのかい？

pages: An old monk is staying in my house. Something strange is going on, but I have no idea what! I've heard that there are demons on the outskirts of town... Is this true?
jp: おらの家に坊さんが泊まってるだ何かえらいことが起こるっつうでいてもたってもいられねぇだ！この町の近くにも魔物が出たって話・・・本当か？

pages: I hear some government guy is coming here! I bet he's gonna make sure all the demons are wiped out!
jp: お上の偉い人が来てるんだって！魔物退治をしてくれるって村中の人が言ってるよ！

pages: Some monk who specializes in killing demons has come here. All the way here to Izumo... I hope our homes will be safe.
jp: 何でも魔物退治の専門家という偉い坊さんまでこの出雲に来ておられるそうじゃ出雲は大丈夫かのう　心配じゃ

pages: The seas are too rough to go out fishing in... And fish are dying, too. What in the world is happening?!
jp: 海が荒れて漁に出れねぇ魚が死んで浮いとる・・・どうなっているんじゃ！

pages: I swear, it looked like the island of Oki was moving... It must be the work of the demons!
jp: 隠岐の島が動いているように見えただ・・・間違いなく魔物のしわざじゃ！

pages: My daughter is serving as a priestess at the Grand Shrine. I hope she's okay... I'm so worried...
jp: おらの娘っこさ　大社の巫女のおつとめばしとるんじゃが無事なのかのぉ？心配じゃ心配じゃ・・・

pages: Huh...? Did that statue just say something?
jp: なっ　なんだ？この地蔵から声がするぞ？

pages: What's this...? I sense... something from this statue!
jp: なに？　この感じ・・・このお地蔵様からだわ！

pages: What? Did this statue just talk or something?
jp: ＷＨＡＴ？この地蔵　しゃべるのか？

pages: Hm... this statue just said something...
jp: ん・・・この地蔵から声がする・・・・・・

pages: Huh?? Weird! I heard a voice!
jp: ？？？？？なンだ　なンだ？　声がするゾ？

pages: What? I heard a voice from this statue...
jp: なんだ？この地蔵から声が聞こえる・・・

pages: The bronze bell... It is a sacred treasure, used since time immemorial to entrap demons and purify their wretched spirits... But if its power were ever misused... It could become a mighty weapon for the demons...
jp: 銅鐸・・・古来　魔を封じ込め浄化するための神器であった・・・しかしその力を逆用すれば・・・魔の者にエネルギーを与える魔器となるであろう・・・

pages: Was I just hearing things?
jp: さっきのは空耳か？

pages: That voice from before... could it have been Mother Nature?
jp: 先程のは大自然の声・・・かしら？

pages: Where did that voice come from?!
jp: さっきの声はいったいどこから？？

pages: This is Izumo... gathering place of the gods... The evil creatures are collecting that power...
jp: ここは出雲・・・神々が集う国・・・邪なる者が・・・その力を求めてやってくる・・・

pages: Heeeey! Were you sleeping?
jp: オーイ！・・・寝ちゃッたのかな？

pages: Hm... must be hearing things...
jp: ふっ・・・空耳か・・・

pages: I'm a priest of Izumo's Grand Shrine... but demons have put up some kind of mystical barrier. I can't get inside, so I have no idea what's going on in there.
jp: 私はこの出雲大社の神主ですが情けないことに魔物の結界があって入ることもできません・・・中の様子もさっはり判りません

pages: Per government orders, that samurai was allowed in... We haven't been able to get back inside since, though.
jp: お上の命令とかでお侍様がひとりで先ほどお入りになりましたが・・・入れなくなったのはそれからです

pages: Just who on Earth are you?
jp: あんたいったい何者じゃ？

pages: Ah, I've been waiting for you.
You must have been training quite diligently...
I sense a particularly harsh spirit within you...
jp: おお　待ちかねたぞずいぶん修行を重ねてきたようじゃのう・・・荒々しいスピリッツが感じられるぞい・・・

pages: Ah, I've been waiting for you.
I sense that your spirit is as lovely and reliable as ever.
That is quite heartening, indeed...
jp: おお待ちかねたぞ相変わらず頼もしくも美しいスピリッツをお持ちじゃのうまったく心強いわい・・・

pages: Ah, I've been waiting for you.
I sense that your spirit still burns with a sense of justice...
jp: おお　待ちかねたぞ相変わらず正義感に燃えたスピリッツを発しておるな・・・

pages: Ah, I've been waiting for you.
I sense that you have not changed very much...
Your calm demeanor still belies your tempestuous inner nature.
jp: おお　待ちかねたぞ相変わらず静かな物腰の中にも激しいスピリッツを感じるぞい

pages: Ah, I've been waiting for you.
I see that your spirit is just as bright and cheerful as ever.
jp: おお　待ってたよ相変わらず元気いっはいのスピリッツをしとるのう

pages: How can you be so easygoing? What exactly is going on?
I demand an explanation!
jp: 何をのんきなコト言ってるんだ！いったい　何が起こってるんだ？説明しろってんだよ！

pages: It's been quite some time, Master Nicotine!
So what's going? Is Izumo gotten involved in an evil plot?
jp: 和狆様　お久しぶりです！何ですか？この出雲に渦巻く邪悪な力は！？

pages: Yep! It's been awhile, Mister Nicotine!
I got your message, obviously! So what's going on?
jp: ハーイ！　和狆殿久しぶりね！ところでいきなりのメールいったい何事ね？

pages: It's been a long time, Nicotine. From the sound of your letter,
some influence of Hell is at work here in Izumo...
jp: 和狆殿お久しぶりです手紙ではこの出雲に魔界の動きがあると・・・

pages: Hiya, grampy! Do you have any bananas? I love bananas!
jp: やッほー　じいちゃン！バナナンは？　バナナン！

pages: No need to hurry...
Rushing into things will only lead to our ultimate defeat.
Now, be silent and listen...
jp: そうせくな・・・そんなコトではこれからの戦い勝ち抜いてはいけぬぞい・・・まあ黙って聞け・・・

pages: I knew you would understand... but there is more, as well.
Now, listen closely...
jp: やはりわかるか・・・しかしこれからが本番じゃぞまあ聞きなさい・・・

pages: Indeed, the time has come for justice to show its nature.
Now, listen closely...
jp: うむ　おぬしの正義見せて〓うときが来たようじゃまあ聞きなさい・・・

pages: Indeed. I know you have an interest in the subject, too.
Now, listen closely...
jp: ああその通りじゃおぬしも魔界には興味があろうまあ聞きなさい・・・

pages: Y-you can have a banana later.
Actually, this town of Izumo is in grave danger.
I need you to listen closely to what I'm about to tell you.
jp: バ　バナナンは後でな実は今この出雲という国でたいへんなことが起ころうとしているのじゃちょっとワシの話を聞いとくれ

pages: Without a doubt, our foes are not of this world.
Hell itself is invading...
Izumo has been visited by worse omens of the impending
catastrophe than I had thought possible...
jp: ・・・敵は魔物じゃ！間違いなくこの世の者ではない魔界からの大侵略・・・思った以上に大きな災いの兆しがこの出雲に現れておる・・・

pages: But listen, {NAME}! The enemy now is truly fearsome.
You should go and ask one other to join you in your quest.
Rumors abound of warriors from the world over here in town...
So they must be gathering at the bar... why not go and see?
jp: ときに！今回の相手は人外じゃ・・・老〓心ながら仲間をひとりつのることをすすめる・・・この地には全国から腕自慢の侍が魔物退治の噂を聞きつけ集まっていると聞く・・・侍酒場に行くがよい！

pages: I will explain more later...
I also have duties to which I must attend.
Hurry... we have little time!
jp: 〓しい話はそれからじゃ・・・わしも　ちとやらねばならないことがあるしのう急げ・・・時間が無い！

pages: Do you know Yagyu Jubei? He came here to Izumo...
I couldn't stop him... he went in the demons' nest all alone.
If we don't hurry...
Perhaps you should look around town for a bit?
jp: 柳生十兵衛を知っておるか？この出雲に来ておる・・・ワシの止めるのも聞かず・・・ひとりで魔物の巣に飛び込みおった・・・急がねば・・・すまぬが・・・外の様子を見てきてくれぬか？

pages: I also have duties to which I must attend.
You should take the opportunity to look around town.
jp: わしはちとやらねばならんことがあるそれが終わるまで　外の様子を見て来てくれぬか？

pages: Heh! All right, I guess I'll do a little sightseeing.
jp: ふん！　・・・まあいい出雲の町でも見物としゃれ込むか

pages: Be quiet! You're distracting me!
I'm making a talisman to break through the mystic barrier!
jp: ・・・声をかけるな！気が散る！今　魔の結界をやぶる札をつくっておるのじゃ！

pages: That samurai who went in earlier still hasn't come back out... I hope he's all right...
jp: 先ほどお入りになったお侍様はまだ出ていらっしゃいません大丈夫でしょうか・・・

pages: Ook ook!
jp: ウキキィ！

pages: Woof!
jp: バウ！

pages: I still will not recognize your skill with a blade, Genjuro!
Unfortunately, there is very little time...
jp: 今でもおぬしの剣は認めておらん！だがな幻十郎・・・もう一刻のゆうよも無い・・・

pages: I have duties to which I must attend for the moment.
You should investigate around town, for now!
jp: わしは　ちとやらねばならないことがあるのでなおぬしは外の様子を見て来い！

pages: At last, the Lament of Pale Blooms begins. You must choose a single companion to accompany you. Since you can only bring one, choose wisely...
jp: さあ　いよいよ妖花慟哭之章の始まりですお仲間をひとり選んでください選べるのはおひとりだけですから慎重に考えた方がいいですよ

pages: You appear to have found a fine companion. Are you certain of your choice?
jp: 良いお仲間が見つかったようですなそのお方でよろしいですか？はいいいえ
おお　！待っておったぞ！だが　これより先はＣＤを買ってもらわねば進めぬ！東京ゲームショウ専用の体験バージョンなのだすまぬが・・・期待して待っておれ！

pages: So the demons really are attacking here!
jp: やはり魔物が攻めて来るらしいぞ！

pages: Hey, can those demon things really be killed with swords?
jp: なぁ　魔物というものは刀で斬り倒せるものなのか？

pages: Wiping out demons?
I thought something strange was going on around here!
I'm looking for strong foes, but humans are getting dull...
Sounds like it might be fun.
All I want is a few good fights...
jp: 魔物退治？やっはりこのあたりは何か変だと思ってたところだぜ！武者修行の旅も人間相手じゃぁ物足りなくなってきたしな・・・面白そうじゃねぇか俺は強いヤツと戦いてぇそれだけだ・・・

pages: The name's Haohmaru! What do you say we join up?
jp: 俺の名は覇王丸！それじゃあ　行くとするか！

pages: All right, then...
I guess I'll have to look for companions on my own!
jp: そうかよそれじゃあ俺は俺で仲間を探すことにするか！

pages: Hey, someone's with you already. Take good care of them first.
jp: なんだ　先客がいるんじゃねえか仲間は大事にしろよ

pages: I came here because I sensed a disaster threatening Nature...
And as I thought... something is going on.
Please, let us travel together! I sense in you...
A powerful holy spirit...
jp: 大自然の異変を感じながらこの地にやってきました・・・やはり・・・何か起こりつつあるのですねぜひ同行させてください！あなたには・・・聖なるスピリッツを感じます・・・

pages: I'm Nakoruru. It's a pleasure to meet you!
jp: 私はナコルルよろしくお願いします！

pages: I see...I'm sorry to have bothered you.
jp: そうですか・・・無理を言ってごめんなさい

pages: Oh, but you already have someone with you.
jp: もういいお仲間がいらっしゃるんですね

pages: Demon extermination?!
Sounds like just the thing for me!
You got it! That's why I came here! In the name of justice.
I'll be glad to help out!
jp: 魔物退治！？オレのインスピレーションがビンゴだぜ！〓論！　そのために来たんだ！正義の名において・・・協力させてもらうぜ！

pages: Okay! It's settled!
I'm Galford, and this here is my friend, Poppy!
jp: ＯＫ！　話は決まりだ！オレはガルフォードこっちは相棒のパピィだ！

pages: That's too bad...
I guess Poppy and I will have to wait here a little longer.
jp: 残念だが仕方がない・・・もうしばらくパピィとここにいることにするよ

pages: Looks like I can't join up with you, then.
Good luck in your travels!
jp: どうやらオレは　君のパートナーになれないようだ君の旅の無事を祈るよ！

pages: I seek the Perfect Flower, which blooms at the gates of Hell...
Eliminating demons along the way is... merely a side benefit.
Nothing has changed. My skills are meager, but I will help.
jp: 魔界の入口に咲くという究極の花を探し求めて旅をしてきた・・・魔物退治・・・私の旅にもうひとつ目的ができたとしても何も変わらない微力ながらお手伝いいたそう

pages: (cough) My name is Tachibana Ukyo... shall we go? (cough)
jp: ゴホッ　私の名は橘右京では・・・行こうゴホッ　ゴホッ

pages: I see.
jp: そうか

pages: You have... (cough)
a companion already... (cough cough)
jp: 良き友に・・・ゴホッ恵まれたようだなゴホゴホッ

pages: This Jipang place is kinda weird!
But something weird is happening at home, too! So we came here!
We can go with you! But will you get us something to eat?
jp: このジパングという国　何かヘン！ホクの故郷も何かヘン！だからパクパクと旅に出た！一緒に行くことオッケイ！でもゴハンはオマエのおごり！

pages: I'm Cham Cham! And this is Pak Pak!
So let's go! Can we go now?
jp: ホク　チャムチャム！それに子分のパクパク！それじゃ行こう！　すぐ行こう！

pages: Huh? You don't want to? But why not...?
jp: エー！　Ⅵメなの？なンでⅥメなのー！

pages: Oh, you got a friend with you! I'll keep looking for one, too!
jp: なンだ　もうお友だちいるンだぁチャムチャムもお友だち探そう！

pages: Safe journey to the both of you. Ah, yes... If you should happen to see me again, feel free to say hello. I will record your journey for you, so that you may rest. Well, then... do take care.
jp: 旅の道連れとは一蓮〓生よい旅をなさってくださいねそうそう旅の途中で私にあったらお声をかけてください旅の記録を作ってさしあげますそれでは　いってらっしゃい

pages: Very well, then go and choose again, but think carefully. This journey may be a long and arduous one.
jp: では　もう一度選びなおしましょうよ～く考えてくださいね〓くて長い旅になるのですから

pages: My native land of France is being overtaken by evil...
And the source appears to be in Japan! Shall we join up?
That is, after all, why I came!
jp: 祖国フランスに立ちこめる魔界の暗雲・・・やはり元凶　この地にあったか！ぜひ同行させてもらいたい！私はそのためにここに来たのだ！

pages: My thanks. My name is Charlotte.
You can count on me.
jp: すまない私の名はシャルロットよろしく頼む

pages: A pity... I seem to have wasted my time.
jp: しかたがないか・・・無理を言ってしまったようだな

pages: You seem to already have a fine companion with you.
jp: 良い仲間にめぐり会えたようだな

pages: Demon extermination, you say? Most interesting!
I would not mind showing the minions of hell...
the myriad subtleties of my dancing blade!
jp: 魔物退治とな？　面白い！我が剣の舞・・・魔界の者にもたっぷり披露して進ぜよう！

pages: Ah, excellent! My name is Senryo Kyoshiro.
Let us be off at once!
jp: あいや　ありがたい！わしの名は千両狂死郎では早速　参ろうぞ！

pages: Oh, my! That's a pity...
jp: なんと！残念な・・・

pages: Ah, you have a friend with you. Something to be treasured!
jp: 良き友は何にもまさる宝大切になされよ！

pages: I'm still inexperienced as a priestess...
But I can't just sit idly by while this disaster happens!
Please! Take me with you!
jp: まだ巫女としては未熟ですが・・・この異変　ほぉっておけないよ！連れてって！　お願い！

pages: I'm Rimururu! It's nice to meet you!
Well, shall we get going?
jp: あたしリムルル！これからよろしくね！それじゃ行きましょ！

pages: Fine, then! I'll find someone else...
jp: いいもん！他の人を探すから・・・

pages: Oh... you're with someone. How boring!
jp: なんだ・・・もういるんだつまんなーい！

pages: Accept companion?
jp: 仲間にしますか？はいいいえ

pages: Nakoruru! I knew it!
You just up and left all of a sudden!
jp: 姉さん！！・・・やっはり気になるモン！飛び出してきちゃった！

pages: You're not ready for this! What were you thinking?!
Go back home to Kamuy Kotan!
jp: あなたにはまだ無理よ！何を考えてるの？カムイコタンに帰りなさい！

pages: No! I want to fight by your side! Take me with you!
jp: いや！　姉さんと一緒に戦うの！一緒に連れてって！

pages: Please! Let me come with you!
jp: お願い！一緒に連れてって！

pages: Oh, all right. But you'd better do as I tell you!
jp: もう　しようがないわねぇ・・・絶対　私の言うことをきくのよ！

pages: Yaaay! I love you, big sis!
jp: ラッキー！姉さんだぁーい好き！

pages: Enough of this! This isn't just some game!
jp: いい加減にしなさい！遊びじゃないのよ！

pages: Oh, Nakoruru... you already have someone with you.
Well, that's no fun.
jp: あっ　姉さん・・・仲間みつけたんだつまんないの

pages: We shall defeat this creature together, then!
jp: 共に魔物を倒そうぞ！

pages: Let's go!
jp: ・・・行くぞ！

pages: Let's go!
jp: ・・・行くぞ！

pages: All right, show me what you've got!
jp: その力　見せてもらおう！

pages: Very well! Let's go!
jp: ・・・まあ良い！行くぞ！

pages: The strongest of all demons...
Nicotine and I both have come to Izumo in pursuit of it.
jp: ・・・最悪の魔人だ・・・和狆殿もワシも　そのミツキの動きを追ってこの出雲に参った

pages: Demons of pure anxiety...
Or of utter hopelessness...
jp: その魂で　不安という魔物・・・絶望という魔物・・・恐怖という魔物を・・・

pages: They must be killed! Are you up to the task...?
jp: 斬ってもらいたい！できるかな・・・

pages: I shouldn't have brought Rimururu!
jp: リムルルをつれて行くなんて！

pages: Ook!
jp: キキッ！！

pages: Woof!!
jp: バウ！！！

pages: Screeee!
jp: ピィィ！！

pages: Do you want to know about how things work here at the smithy?
jp: お前さん　鍛冶屋のことが知りたいのかね？知りたいいや　けっこう

pages: Well, in addition to tempering your sword to make it stronger, you can also imbue it with various elemental attributes.
jp: なら　武器を鍛える上でとても重要な属性の説明をしよう

pages: There are seven different types of elements. {81}{82}, {83}{84}, {85}{86}, {87}{88}, Ice, {91}{92}, and there's the lack of one, or {79}{80}.

pages: I ain't seen the Master in a while now...

Was I just hearing things?

Where did that voice come from?!
This is Izumo... gathering place of the gods... The evil creatures are collecting that power...
Heeeey! Were you sleeping?
Hm... must be hearing things...
I'm a priest of Izumo's Grand Shrine... but demons have put up some kind of mystical barrier. I can't get inside, so I have no idea what's going on in there.

Ah, I've been waiting for you.

I sense a particularly harsh spirit within you...
Ah, I've been waiting for you.

That is quite heartening, indeed...
Ah, I've been waiting for you.
I sense that your spirit still burns with a sense of justice...
Ah, I've been waiting for you.
I sense that you have not changed very much...

Ah, I've been waiting for you.

I knew you would understand... but there is more, as well.
Now, listen closely...

Now, listen closely...

Now, listen closely...

I need you to listen closely to what I'm about to tell you.

Do you want to know about how things work here at the smithy?
Well, in addition to tempering your sword to make it stronger, you can also imbue it with various elemental attributes.
There are seven different types of elements. {81}{82}, {83}{84}, {85}{86}, {87}{88}, Ice, {91}{92}, and there's the lack of one, or {79}{80}.
{81}{82} works well against {83}{84}. {83}{84} works well against {87}{88}. {87}{88} is effective against {85}{86}, and {85}{86} works well against {81}{82}.

The Ice{160}{161}{91}{92} elements are strong against each other, of course. And the last of them, {79}{80}, is kind of a jack of all trades. It's not especially strong or weak against anything. {79}{80} excluded, if you hit an enemy of the same type as your sword, they will simply cancel each other out. So be careful...

pages: I thought it was a strawberry, but it was a red pepper! Whoa, that was hot! I'll never sneak food again!
jp: イチゴだと思ったらトーガラシだったーカライよー！もうつまみ食いはしないよー

pages: Peace and harmony are the best!
jp: やはり平和が一番ですね！

pages: This dojo is very famous, you know.
jp: この道場　評判いいんですよ

pages: I worry about him sometimes... I just don't want him to push himself too hard.
jp: あの人　無理をしすぎじゃないかしら・・・体を壊さないか心配だわ・・・

pages: My cooking is so delicious that you'll never forget it!
jp: 私の料理の味は忘れられなくなるほどうまいアルよ

pages: You were able to help my dad, so I gotta keep working, too.
jp: 父ちゃんたちの力になれるよう僕もがんばってるよ

pages: I am Wan-Fu! And I have swept this town clean of demons!
I have heard stories of you!
You travel the world, seeking to destroy the Animus Bells...
It sounds like a massive task, and I pray for your success!
jp: わたしが王虎だ！この北京の魔物は一〓した！おぬしたちのうわさは聞いている！世界をめぐり邪銅鐸を破壊しているそうだなたいへんだろうが　がんばってくれ成就をいのっている！

pages: I am Wan-Long... Wan-Fu's older brother, if not by much. The Animus Bell in our land has already been destroyed! We cannot leave here, though, so we must leave the rest to you!
jp: わたしは王竜王虎の兄にあたる者だこの国の邪銅鐸はすでに我ら兄弟が破壊済みだ！我らはこの国を離れられん他の国はおぬしたちにまかせたぞ！

pages: So Wan-Fu has a twin brother...
jp: 王虎殿には双子の兄弟がおられるのか・・・

pages: Is... is that... a steamed meat bun?! Those are my absolute favorite! Don't tell me the head chef over at the restaurant made it... He did! I can tell! That smell, the very look of it... I... I can't bear just looking at it... I have to have it!
jp: こ・・・こ・・・これは・・・肉まん！？ワタシの大好物アル！しかも北京菜館の料理長自ら手がけた絶品アルな！？間違いない！この香り　このツヤ・・・みみみ　見るだけでもうよだれが出て〓抱たまらんアルよ！

pages: What?! You mean you're just going to give this delicacy to me?! You must be the nicest folks ever to walk the earth! Oh, you want to pass through? Sure, go ahead! The palace is straight ahead through here! Lots of invisible walls, though, so it's easy to get lost! Plus it's full of demons! Be extra careful!
jp: なんと！？この肉まんをワタシにくれるアルか！？アナタとってもいい人アル！ここ　通りたい？　いいアルよ！ここから　まっすぐ進むと死禁城アル！城の中　見えないカベあるアルよ迷うアルよ！おまけに　魔物だらけアル！気をつけるアルよ！

pages: You'd better kill Lady Youkihi, you know... If you don't, I'm going to be in some serious trouble.
jp: 必ず　妖貴妃をやっつけるアルよそうでないとワタシ困っちゃうアル

pages: This is Peking... Our hero, Lord Wan-Fu, has driven the demons out of the palace to the north! Everyone's really fired up to work on rebuilding! Please feel free to stay as long as you like.
jp: ここは北京・・・我らの英雄　王虎さまが死禁城に巣喰う魔物を追い出してくれたアルよ！みんな再建の希望に燃えているアルね！旅のお方ゆっくりしていって欲しいアルよ

pages: This is Peking... Demons really did a number on our city, but we'll be okay. And we have you to thank for that!
jp: ここは北京・・・魔物に荒らされたこの町も元の活気を取り戻しているアルよこれもあなたたちのおかげアルよ！謝謝！

pages: Thanks to you, the merchants have returned. We'll be able to replenish our stock of ingredients soon... Just wait, and we'll have everyone well fed again!
jp: アナタたちのおかげで商人が戻ってきたアルもう少ししたら材料入ってくるヨ腕によりをかけてお礼するネお腹すかせて待ってるよろし！

pages: So, how was the meat bun?
jp: 肉まんは　いかがだったアルか？

pages: And how do you know about that, pops?
jp: ・・・ほぉ　じいさんなんでそんなことがわかるんだ？

pages: So you... somehow know about everything...?
jp: まるで・・・全てをお見通しになっているよう

pages: Huh?! Hey, mister... just who the hell are you...?
jp: うッ！？おじいサンアナタはいったい・・・

pages: Wha...?! He's gone!
jp: げげっ！消えちまっ・・・た？

pages: Eek! What in...?! Where'd he go?
jp: きゃ！何！？どうしたの？

pages: Wow! Was that ninjutsu?!
jp: ＷＯＷッ！？ニンジュツか！？

pages: Hmm! That was bizarre...!
jp: むむっ！　面妖な！？

pages: Whoa! What the hell?!
jp: なッ！？ナンだ？　ナンⅥ？　なンⅥ！？

pages: What the...?! Was he... another demon?
jp: ぬうっ！？　こやつまさか・・・魔物か！

pages: Heh heh heh...
Just wanted to say thanks for all your hard work...!
Heh heh... uh...
jp: へっへっへっ・・・いつもおつとめご苦労さんっす！へへへ・・・あのー・・・

pages: I just wanted you to know how much I appreciate what you do.
So... um... here...
jp: 毎日ご苦労様ですねあの・・・これを・・・

pages: Gooood morning! Looks like we're in for a nice day today!
jp: ＨＥＹ　グッモーニンッ！今日はとってもナイスデイね！

pages: Here you go...
You hungry?
jp: おナカすいたか？

pages: Hmph... what's with the gloomy look...?
Hey, Reon! Get your shit together!
jp: ふん・・・まったく不景気なツラをしておるわ・・・おい　鈴音！例のプツをくれてやれ！

pages: Give the Steamed Meat Bun to the gatekeeper?
jp: 門番に「肉まん」を差し入れますか？はいいいえ

pages: (sniff sniff)... Wha... what is that wonderful smell...?
jp: くんくん・・・な・・・なんだかいい匂いがするアルな・・・

pages: (Guess I'll have to do it myself.)
We just wanted to bring you a gift for all your hard work...
jp: ・・・・・・（自分でやればいいのに）いつも門番　ご苦労だなそこでだな・・・

pages: By the way, I haven't seen Lord Wan-Long around in awhile... I don't know why, but that makes me nervous...
jp: そういえば王竜様のお姿も見ないな・・・なぜか胸騒ぎがする・・・

pages: Maybe he's been ensorcelled by the demons somehow... Please, won't you help him? I know you're strong enough!
jp: もし王虎様が　魔に魅入られているのならば・・・どうか　師を救ってください！あなた方のお力なら必ずや王虎様を・・・お願いいたします！

pages: Well, when you put it like that, how can I say no?
All right! You stay here, then.
I'll find some way into that palace thingy...
and bust Wan-Fu out of jail!
jp: なるほど　そこまで言われちゃ断れないねぇよおし！ここはいっちょうなんとか城とやらに乗り込んで王虎のおっさんを助け出してやるとするか！

pages: I understand. We will do as you ask, then.
We'd be glad to help out however we can...
And hopefully free Peking from demonic influence entirely!
jp: わかりましたわたしたちで良ければ喜んでお手伝いさせていただきます・・・そして北京に立ちこめている悪の瘴気も打ち払って来ましょう！

pages: All right! I hear what you're saying.
We'll get into the bad guy's hideout and get back Wan-Fu!
For justice! Let's go, Poppy! Come on, everyone!
jp: オーライッ！話はわかったぜこれから悪の本拠地に乗り込んでミスター王虎を奪い返してみせるぜフォー・ジャスティス！行くぜパピィ！　みんなっ！

pages: I never could say no to a beautiful woman.
Even though we come from two different nations...
The feeling of missing loved ones lost differs not at all...
Fear not. You can count on me.
Despite my meager abilities, I will do all that I can...
jp: 美しいご婦人の頼みとあらばお断りするわけにはいきませんそれにあなたたち・・・住む国は違えど主君・師匠を慕う気持ちは変わらない・・・この右京　武人のはしくれとして微力ながらお手伝いさせていただこう・・・

pages: You got it! Just leave it all up to me!
I'll beat up the bad guys and bring Wan-Fu back home!
jp: わかッたゾ！よおし　チャムチャムにまかせろ！悪いヤツはペンペンして王虎のおじちゃン助け出してやるゾ

pages: Hahaha... Well, there's a surprise...
Do all of your rulers need my help, or just the latest one?
jp: ふふふ・・・なんだ王虎とやらもこの程度の部下しか持たぬとは存外に小物と見える・・・

pages: Genjuro!
jp: ・・・おいっ　幻十郎ッ！

pages: Heh... why would I want to risk my own neck to save him?
His own stupidity got him into this, so let him pay the price.
I'd rather just go drinking... Let's go, Reon.
jp: ふん　主の命を厳守して見殺しにする間抜けぶり酒のさかなにもなりはせぬ・・・鈴音　行くぞ

pages: (sigh)...
I understand... let me handle things with Wan-Fu.
I swear, I'll get him back!
jp: ちっ・・・わかりました王虎殿はこの鈴音にお任せを・・・必ず救い出してご覧に入れます！

pages: Thank you so much...
jp: ありがとうございます・・・

pages: Hmph...
jp: ふん・・・

pages: The rumors about Lord Wan-Fu are really getting to me... If I could, I'd love to get into the palace and find the truth. But Lord Wan-Fu himself ordered me to stay and guard the dojo. I can't disobey a direct order, can I?
jp: 王虎様の噂か・・・気になる・・・本当に気になるできることなら今すぐにでも死禁城に乗り込んで真実を確かめてやりたいのだが・・・王虎様から道場を守れと堅く仰せつかっておりまして・・・我々にとって王虎様の命令は絶対なのです

pages: I'm so happy to have Wan-Fu back home... Thank you so much...
jp: 王虎様がご無事で　本当に良かった・・・ありがとうございます・・・

pages: I guess Lord Wan-Long... Well, I imagine he wants to know what his brother is thinking... Curse those demons!
jp: なんと王竜様が・・・くくっ　王虎様のご心境察するにあまりある・・・・・・魔物どもめ！

pages: In any case, any creature that could lead such great men to such terrible deeds must be truly dreadful, indeed...
jp: それにしても王虎様と王竜様・・・ふたりの豪傑を手玉に取るとは魔物の恐ろしさは底が知れぬ・・・

pages: Lord Wan-Fu was able to recover his wits on his own... But Lord Wan-Long... They just seem to have different views on rulership.
jp: 王虎様は自力で正気に戻られたのに王竜様は・・・おふたりの望んだ王道の差と言ってしまうのは残酷でしょうか

pages: The only stores open are this inn and the apothecary... Everyone's been imprisoned in Tiananmen, though.
jp: 店はこの宿と薬屋しかやってないアルよみんな天安門の中につかまってしまったアル

pages: Everyone's safe again! Thank you! But still... what could Lady Youkihi be thinking?
jp: みんなを助けてくれたアルか！ありがとうアル！しかし・・・妖貴妃さまはなにを考えているアルか・・・

pages: Lady Youkihi was a demon?! Is this true?! I can't believe it...
jp: 妖貴妃さまは魔物だったアルか！それは本当アルか！？信じられないアルよ・・・

pages: Lords Wan-Fu and Wan-Long are working together again...! Now, all of Peking can relax!
jp: 王虎様と王竜様はおふたりで力をあわせがんばってくださっているアル！北京は安心アルよ！！

pages: Not too long ago, Peking had a huge demon problem! But thanks to Lords Wan-Fu and Wan-Long, it's all okay now!
jp: 少し前までこの北京は魔物で大騒ぎだったアルよ！でも　王虎さま！　王竜さまのおかげで助かったアルよ！

pages: I see... well, come again sometime, then.
jp: そうアルかまた　来るアルよ

pages: Xie xie!
jp: ありがとうアルね！

pages: Wan-Long isn't at the dojo anymore... He and my husband, Wan-Fu, had a falling out, and he left...
Wan-Long isn't at the dojo anymore... He and my husband, Wan-Fu, had a falling out, and he left...
jp: 王竜はもうこの道場にはいません・・・夫の王虎と意見が合わず道場から出ていってしまって・・・

pages: Thank you very much! Wan-Fu came back to the dojo safely... Even though he only shouted to ask if I was all right... He left right away again, to go to the palace to the north. I can't help but be worried about him...
jp: ありがとうございました！あの人が　王虎が・・・道場に無事な姿を見せて・・・もっとも「無事かぁ」と大声をあげただけですぐに行ってしまいましたけど・・・真の漢ならどうのこうのとそのまま　死禁城の方へ・・・なんだか　心配だわ

pages: How... how could Wan-Long have done such terrible things...? To consort with demons and fight against his own brother... What a dreadful man...
jp: ・・・王竜が　王竜がそんなことになっていたなんて・・・兄弟同士に骨肉の争いをさせるとは魔物とはなんと残酷で恐ろしいものなのでしょうか・・・

pages: Good travelers, you look to be more than a mere glance shows... Have a listen to the ramblings of a doddering old fool... I was once Grand Chamberlain of The forbidden palace, you know! Lady Youkihi was once a truly good person! But she changed... She suddenly began arresting all the people and placing them in the prisons of Tiananmen, and blocked it off from the town. The world-famous forbidden palace is crawling with demons. I tried to get her to stop... but she wouldn't listen... In fact, I barely got out of there alive...
jp: 旅の方・・・ただ者ではなさそうじゃじいの繰り言でも聞いとくれ・・・じいはこれでも死禁城の侍従長だったのじゃぞ！妖貴妃さまは良いお方じゃった！しかし　突然に変わられた・・・人々を捕らえては天安門に幽閉し北京の町を封鎖し・・・世に聞こえた死禁城はほれ　魔物の巣窟と化しておる必死で忠言したのじゃが・・・聞き入れてもらえぬばかりか殺されかけて・・・命からがら逃げてまいったのじゃ

pages: Lord Wan-Fu would never betray his people! He may be a little brusque, but he's a fine man! I'm sure he needs to discuss politics with Lady Youkihi!
jp: 王虎殿に限って悪に荷担することはあり得ぬ！少々荒っほいところはあるがあの方こそ漢の中の漢じゃ！この間も死禁城に出向き妖貴妃さまに御政道の過ちを堂々と直言しておられたぐらいじゃ！

pages: Lord Wan-Long always relied too much on brute force... I think that was always his real weak point, honestly. Though he looks just like his brother, and is just as strong, he's got a long way to go before he'd be as strong as a ruler.
jp: 王竜殿は力に頼り過ぎのようじゃったのう・・・それが王竜殿のゆいいつの弱点と言えるわい武人としては互角でもご器量の点では　武以外にも道を探そうとされる王虎殿に一歩お譲りすることになるじゃろうな

pages: Milady... I see the time has come for an old man to serve once again...
jp: 妃さま・・・このわしも　老体にむち打ち最後のご奉公をせねばならぬときが来たようじゃ・・・

pages: What? Lord Wan-Fu is okay? Thank goodness! But he must have been under some extremely powerful spell...
jp: おお！　王虎様は無事アルか！しかし王虎様をたぶらかすとはとんでもない魔力アルなー

pages: Aha, so that's what was going on! I knew it all along... Lord Wan-Fu would never try to hurt his own people!
jp: やっはりそんなことだったアルか！信じてたアルね王虎様がワシらを苦しめるはずがないアルよ！

pages: This gate's been closed for a long time... It's meant to keep out all of the demons... Problem is, it also means that we can't escape if we need to.
jp: この門はずっと前から閉鎖されているのヨ・・・外には魔物がウヨウヨいるから北京を守るためだっていうけどホントは　アタシたちが北京から逃げ出せないようにしているんだワ

pages: Lord Wan-Fu was always so kind... And so strong... I'll... I'll never believe in anyone ever again!
jp: 王虎サマって・・・とっても優しくて・・・とっても強い人だったのに・・・アタシ　もう誰も信用できない！

pages: Yaaaaaay!! The gate should be opening up soon, so I can play outside!
jp: ウレシイ！！この門が開いて外で遊べる日も近いのネ！

pages: With Lord Wan-Fu here, those demons won't get near Peking ever again!
jp: 王虎サマがいるんだモンもう二度と魔物は北京に近付けないのヨ！

pages: Damn it... is my dad really working with demons...?
jp: くそっ・・・オイラの父ちゃんが魔物なものか！！

pages: I still say that my dad's gonna come back okay.
jp: オイラ　みんなが父ちゃんを連れて帰ってくれるって信じてるよ

pages: Ah, so it's you! I've been in your debt for some time now!
Many rumors abound of your exploits, you know...
You've sought to slay the demons and undo the damage done by Lady
Youkihi and my brother... to say nothing of the Animus Bell!
Let us work to foil the schemes of Mizuki!
jp: おお　おぬしら！いつぞやは世話になった！おぬしたちの噂は聞いておるぞあれから　兄弟　力を合わせて妖貴妃さまに化けておった魔物をぶち殺し　ついでに邪銅鐸もぶっつぶしてくれたわ！ミツキの企み共にぶちバラしてやろうぞ！

pages: You must be the ones who helped our rulers... Thank you so much!
jp: おぬしが我ら兄弟を救ってくれたそうだな・・・礼を言うぞ！

pages: This is Wan-Fu's dojo, but the master himself is not in. Is there anything I can assist you with?
jp: ここは王虎道場だが道場主の王虎様が今おられぬ代理のわたしでよければ相手になれるが？

pages: You guys are amazing! I couldn't do anything to help at all...
jp: あなたがたは強すぎる！わたしは何の役にも立たぬ・・・

pages: Have you come to train and increase your strength?
jp: 力が欲しいなら修行をするがいいはいいいえ

pages: Then try your hand at fighting these...
jp: ならば　コイツと戦ってみろ

pages: I see. Well, let me know if you should change your mind.
jp: そうか気が変わったらいつでも来い

pages: Well done! Excellent form.
jp: おお　素晴らしきその技！賞賛に値するぞ

pages: Well done! I will pray for your continued safety...
jp: 見事であった！道中の無事を祈っているぞ

pages: A pity... Come back when you wish to try again.
jp: あきらめず力をつけて　また来い

pages: Oh... it seems you already know everything I could teach you.
jp: おや　わたしの〓古は〓に終えておるはずだが？

jp: 誰の武器を鍛えるアルか？

pages: Are you all right? You look like you've seen some tough fights.
My name is Sieger.
Go to the inn and find the Holy Knights of the Red Lion.
We can strike together at Mizuki's lackey, St. Germain!
Let's go, Nachtmusik!
jp: 無事であったか！貴公らの戦いなかなかのモノ私の名は　⑥ィーガー「紅き獅子聖騎士団」の宿をぜひ訪ねてくれ共にミツキの手先　サンゼルマンを迎え撃とう！行くぞ！　ナハトムジーク！

jp: 私は「ファントム魔術師団」団長のルーだ　よろしくな・・・邪銅鐸といわれる魔界の兵器をお探しなのだろうが　我々も情報を集めている最中なのじゃ

pages: St. Germain...? We have to prepare ourselves!
jp: サンゼルマンか・・・腕がなるぜ！

pages: St. Germain possesses incredible power... You must be careful.
jp: サンゼルマンは圧倒的な力を身につけている心してかかられよ
